title: Deol Family Estate Winery
specs: 18 acre vineyard with 8 varieties of grapes including Pinot Gris, Pinot Noir, Marechal Foch and Gamay Noir.
Picnic area with tables on patio and outside wine shop for visitors to relax and enjoy wine.
gap: No tasting fees or tour prices stated
blurb: Deol Family Estate Winery grows 8 varieties of grapes on an 18-acre vineyard and produces wines from 100% estate-grown grapes. Visitors can enjoy wine tasting and relax in a picnic area with scenic views. Wines are available for purchase onsite, at the Duncan Farmers Market, or online via their Shopify account.
